family_title_en: Complete the word with the correct short vowel

stages.ix_title: Complete the word with the correct short vowel
stages.choice_rule: Offer exactly four lowercase letters from a, e, i, o, and u. One letter fills the hyphen gap so the short-vowel word fits the sentence. Tier 1 wrong letters spell no roots-list word. Tier 2 has one roots-list trap, or a two-syllable target with none. Tier 3 has two roots-list traps.

gold_items.stem: The kids go on a b-s.
The little pet is a p-g.
The frog is on a l-g.
Mom put b-tter on the hot bread.
The dog will s-t on the mat today.
<NAME> l-st a red hat at school today.

roots: Choices are four lowercase vowel letters from a, e, i, o, and u, never consonants or whole words.
The stem has one hyphen gap from allowed_extra_words. That gap stands for one short vowel letter.
Every other stem word is on the roots list, or the token <NAME>. Ignore capitals and end punctuation.
Exactly one letter makes the short-vowel word that fits the sentence. Two answers is a failed item.
Tier 1 wrong letters must not spell any word on the roots list.
Tier 2 uses one roots-list trap that does not fit, such as peg for pig or better for butter, or a two-syllable target with no trap.
Tier 3 uses two roots-list traps. Meaning or grammar, such as will or lost, leaves one word that fits.
Do not gap a long vowel. Do not make put, ball, tall, fall, most, or want the gapped target.
List junk such as jum, dag, ron, or halp is not a target and is not a good trap. Use real kid words.
Kid topics only: school, home, food, pets, play, family, and weather. No brands and no real names.
Do not copy a gold stem. The same target word may appear at most three times, each time in a new sentence.
Set explain_key from the correct letter: short_a, short_e, short_i, short_o, or short_u.
If the stem contains <NAME>, set that item swap_slots NAME to names.txt.

tier_rules.1: Short stems of four to six words with one CVC gap. Among the four letter choices, only the correct letter spells a word on the roots list.
tier_rules.2: Stems of five to eight words. Use one roots-list trap that does not fit, or a two-syllable target whose other vowels spell no list word. Do not use two traps.
tier_rules.3: Stems of seven to ten words. Exactly two wrong letters spell roots-list words, and only one word fits the meaning or the grammar.
